context: A grandpa tells his young grandson an old folk tale
purpose: Teach: 遺産/塔/天国/悪魔/天使/牧師/東洋/特有

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: 昔々、ある村の牧師さんが、東洋に伝わる不思議な塔の話を聞いたんじゃ。
lines.en: Long ago, a village pastor heard about a mysterious tower passed down in the East.
lines.style: Warm storytelling cadence, slow nostalgic rhythm with grandfatherly drawl.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 塔って、どんな塔なの？高いやつ？
lines.en: A tower? What kind of tower? A tall one?
lines.style: Bright curious child voice with rising eager pitch.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: それはのう、天国まで届くと言われた、その地域特有の古い塔じゃった。
lines.en: Well, it was said to reach heaven, an old tower unique to that region.
lines.style: Hushed reverent tone, drawn out vowels for mystery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 天国！じゃあ天使もいたの？
lines.en: Heaven! So were there angels too?
lines.style: Excited high-pitched gasp, wide-eyed wonder in voice.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: 天使もおったが、塔の下にはな、人の心を奪う悪魔も棲んでおったそうじゃ。
lines.en: There were angels, but beneath the tower lurked a devil who stole hearts.
lines.style: Lowered ominous tone, slow deliberate menacing pacing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: こわい…牧師さんはどうしたの？
lines.en: Scary... what did the pastor do?
lines.style: Quieter trembling child voice, slight nervous hesitation.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: 牧師さんは村人を守るため、先祖の遺産である古い鈴を持って、塔へ向かったんじゃ。
lines.en: To protect the villagers, the pastor took an old bell, an ancestral heirloom, and headed to the tower.
lines.style: Steady determined tone, rising heroic warmth in delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 鈴で悪魔を追い払ったの？すごい！
lines.en: He drove away the devil with a bell? Amazing!
lines.style: Loud delighted exclamation, bouncing childish enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: そうじゃ。だから今でもその鈴は、わしらの大事な遺産として残っとるんじゃよ。
lines.en: Indeed. That is why even now, the bell remains as our precious heritage.
lines.style: Gentle satisfied closing tone, warm grandfatherly smile in voice.
